title: Anyone taking on work right now?
content: Hi I'm u/PattayaVagabond , one of mall world's biggest employers. I know everyone's busy with their own lives, but I do have a couple projects I am working on in mall world, and I could use as a hand! In exchange I can gift you some days in either the brothel or the pool rooms where I've built some connections. If you'd be interested in learning more about the project send me a DM with some info about your experience with mall world and your time zone!
